Primary action: D - retain local diagnosis only and defer run-ahead screening; narrowest role: retrospective numerical reconciliation of already-validated local predictions, not promotion or re-execution. Disposition defer, recommendation_id null, next_action finish, route stop, zero operational next_research budget.

Coarse production reproduction is effectively exact: regenerated cold states vs saved trajectories differ by 2.62e-11 m (f-0) and 9.19e-10 m (f-1) position, speed differences 4.30e-10 and -8.38e-08 m/s, velocity-norm differences 2.62e-09 and 9.20e-08 m/s at 0.30 s. Reconstruction is thus not the error source.

Initial errors at 0.30 s are projection-dominated: initial position error norms 0.0026892 and 0.0026890 m with projection components [6.54e-4,-1.69e-3,-1.99e-3] m; initial speed projection errors only 1.68e-05 and -5.81e-05 m/s. Over the 0.01 s interval, position change-error norms are 9.07e-05 and 5.71e-05 m; velocity change-error norms 7.27e-03 and 6.76e-03 m/s; speed change-error -6.35e-03 and -5.13e-03 m/s. Endpoint position error norms 2.63e-03 and 2.68e-03 m; endpoint velocity error norms 7.49e-03 and 6.93e-03 m/s. The change/endpoint velocity discrepancy (~7e-3 m/s) is larger than the speed-norm change error (~6e-3 m/s): a speed-norm match is NOT a vector match, and the x-axis dominates directionally.

Refinement is negligible and non-converging: 0.01 to 0.002 to 0.001 s (1/5/10 steps, all root_residual_verified) changes endpoint position error norm only 2.63190e-03 to 2.70852e-03 to 2.71856e-03 (f-0) and 2.67990e-03 to 2.71934e-03 to 2.72428e-03 (f-1) - slightly increasing, so no single finer value certifies convergence. Coarse/fine differences are 1.21e-05 and 6.94e-06 m position, 2.07e-04 and 1.29e-04 m/s speed, 2.47e-04 and 1.73e-04 m/s velocity-norm; the speed/velocity differences straddle the 1e-4 m/s reporting tolerance, so step resolution is marginally material at that tolerance yet cannot explain the ~7e-3 m/s change error.

At 0.30 s the settled-seed rule makes the check weight-independent: 0.05/0.075/0.15 all yield identical first_command_n equal to previous_input_n, selected_iteration 0, selected_plan_is_seed true, optimized_before_acceptance false, stop_reason verified_settled_seed, initial scaled violation 5.28e-12, maximum_selected_plan_error 1.360e-03 m (<0.005 m) and maximum_selected_plan_speed 1.992e-02 m/s (<0.02 m/s). Because the seed already clears both thresholds the callback stops at iteration zero before any weight-dependent update, so the weights never diverge - this degenerate acceptance cannot test weight sensitivity. At 0.20 s seeds are not settled (optimized, selected_iteration 5, stop relative_seed_improvement), weights do differ (objectives 1.7375e-02/1.7399e-02/1.7470e-02), and maximum_selected_plan_speed 2.513e-02 m/s exceeds the 0.02 limit.

Unresolved causes: historical warm plans are absent and production states/inputs/solver paths differ (state_difference_from_common_preview_norm up to 0.46), so no warm-start-only attribution; change error bundles projection, omitted modes, transcription and integration and is not isolated dynamics error.
